items.description: Collective decision: instead of tote bags, offer a free fifteen-day home trial of a chair, limited to the Lyon and Grenoble areas.
items.notes: Proposed by Bastien at turn 7, limited by Mehdi at turn 8, put to the group by Hélène at turn 9 and approved by Mehdi and Bastien.

items.description: Hélène's proposal of logo-embroidered tote bags was rejected (four euros each, two thousand euros for five hundred) and dropped in favour of the free trial.
items.notes: Rejected proposal. Reporting it as dropped inside the adopted decision (E1) is acceptable; reporting tote bags as adopted is not.

items.description: Update the brochure price grid before reprinting: Hélène asked Bastien, who explicitly declined to commit; nobody owns it.
items.notes: Bastien's 'we'll talk about it again' is a deferral, not an acceptance, so open is also acceptable.

items.description: Declare the names for the five exhibitor badges before registration closes, otherwise visitor rates apply; nobody took it on.
items.notes: The timing is an event (registration closing), not a date, so due_text_contains is empty.

items.description: Run the motorized chair demonstration on the booth: no owner. Mehdi only imitated Bastien volunteering, Bastien never committed, and Hélène left it until Bastien's schedule is final.
items.notes: The first-person promise at turn 14 is Mehdi imitating Bastien. Bastien says nothing about the demo afterwards.

items.description: Hélène books the hotel rooms for the three nights by Friday, after nobody volunteered.
items.notes: Hélène asked at turn 15, nobody answered, and she took it herself at turn 16.

items.description: Send the hall 3 floor plan tomorrow morning: promised by an unidentified voice, so the owner cannot be confirmed.
items.notes: Nothing identifies the voice as Hélène, Bastien or Mehdi; Mehdi only thanks it.

items.description: Mehdi confirms the exact delivery dock address to the carrier on November 9, corrected from 'before November 6' because the organizer assigns docks on November 8.
items.notes: One commitment corrected in place by its owner; November 6 is no longer the deadline. Original statement at turn 3; change at turn 18, 15 turns later.

items.description: Bastien prepares the booth staffing schedule with his meeting slots and sends it on Monday; asked by Hélène and accepted by Bastien.

forbidden.description: No task, for anyone, to update the brochure price grid.
No task, for anyone, to declare the exhibitor badge names.
No task owned by Bastien for the motorized chair demonstration: the promise is Mehdi's imitation.
No task owned by Mehdi for the demonstration: quoting someone is not committing.
No task, for anyone, to send the hall 3 floor plan: the promising voice is unidentified.
The staffing schedule is not Hélène's task: she asked, Bastien accepted.

forbidden_claims: Bastien agreed to update the brochure price grid.
Bastien or Mehdi is in charge of the motorized chair demonstration.
Hélène, Bastien or Mehdi will send the hall 3 floor plan.
Mehdi confirms the carrier address by November 6.
Tote bags were chosen as giveaways.
The free trial is offered beyond the Lyon and Grenoble areas.
Someone was assigned to declare the exhibitor badge names.
A calendar date (day number or month) is given for Hélène's Friday booking, Bastien's Monday schedule or the voice's 'tomorrow morning'.
detail_checks: Booth of eighteen square meters in hall 3; the fair opens in five weeks.
Forty client meetings over two days; three people needed on the booth at all times.
Six demonstration chairs delivered the morning before the fair.
Tote bags would cost four euros each, two thousand euros for five hundred.
Five exhibitor badges; names due before registration closes, otherwise visitor rates apply.
The address confirmation moved because the organizer assigns docks on November 8.
